visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Ray Du, wearing a black long-sleeved sweatshirt and glasses, stands in a modern indoor kitchen with light-colored walls and wood accents. He faces a large brown cardboard box placed on a wooden dining table. He uses a white utility knife to carefully slice the packing tape on the top of the box. (2) He opens the outer flaps to reveal a white internal box with "THANK YOU" printed on it. He picks up a white card that unfolds into four panels, displaying various channel statistics and a QR code. Yellow captions with white borders appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) He lifts out a vibrant Tiffany blue box featuring a red YouTube play button logo. The setting is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting. He removes the lid to reveal a black-and-white checkered chessboard integrated into the box structure. (4) Ray pulls a drawer from the side of the Tiffany blue box, showcasing clear and translucent black chess pieces secured in foam slots. He begins taking the pieces out and arranging them onto the board. His hands are frequently in a close-up view showing the physical texture of the set. (5) A woman in a brown and beige plaid shirt joins the scene. She gestures towards the chess set with excitement. A brief graphic overlay with a black-and-white movie scene from Harry Potter appears in the center of the frame as they play out a comedic reaction. (6) The camera follows Ray as he walks to a wooden shelf filled with various items, including books, a clear Bearbrick figure, a Marshall speaker, and a vinyl record player. He points at these objects to showcase past milestones. (7) Ray and the woman stand together, smiling and looking directly at the camera. They gesture with their hands while expressing gratitude, with more variety-style captions appearing over their bodies.

(4) [Subtitle]: 哈囉 阿滴. 喔 欸?! 謝謝理事長耶. 好客製喔 (很用心捏💖). (5) [Subtitle]: 喔 好酷喔. 哇 這個很酷耶. 這是我的去年的成績單. (6) [Subtitle]: 阿滴英文 31.9M 2.8M 664.5K. (7) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這個應該是個棋盤. 喔 真的耶. 哇!!! 好讚喔. 哇塞 這個做工. (8) [Subtitle]: Not me. Not Hermione. You. [Variety]: (HP迷懂的). (9) [Subtitle]: ~歷年YT禮物開箱~ 我其實往年都沒有開箱過. 給大家看一下. 我從來都沒有收到過的禮物. 這好像是去年的吧. 這應該是 2018 年的時候. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後這個也是. 這個黑膠 後來被我放東西. (11) [Subtitle]: 今年剛好是阿滴英文 10 週年. [Variety]: (歲月不饒人). 天啊 現在已經十年了嗎. (12) [Subtitle]: 感謝 YouTube. 我也會好好珍惜. [Variety]: (拜託看看我) (懇請支持滴妹). (13) [Subtitle]: 你們接下來要送我的禮物. 真的.
